_comment: Explicit EDGAR scope. EDGAR is a WORKED-EXAMPLE engine, not decoration. It appears ONLY in finance-relevant modules, integrated into the lesson (like Apple in Accounting). Non-financial modules (negotiation, leadership, culture, etc.) intentionally have NO EDGAR — filings teach nothing there.

01-accounting.role: read the 3 statements on a real 10-K; Apple vs Microsoft financial shape

02-corporate-finance.role: build a DCF / margins from real cash flows; high-growth vs stable cashcow

04-competitive-strategy.role: Five Forces backed by real risk factors + segment economics

05-marketing-brand.role: brand pricing power read in gross margin

06-operations.role: inventory turns / margin structure; Amazon vs Walmart ops

E2-capital-allocation.role: buybacks vs reinvestment from real cash-flow statements

E4-governance-board.role: DEF 14A proxies: exec comp + board structure
